title: Digest-keyed test-execution annotation (ADR-028)
x-source: deliverables/aws-lineage-collection-plan/01-decision-records.md ADR-028 decision 3 ('the evidence attaches to the digest as an execution-confirmed-in-test facet')
x-normativity: Shape normative here. This annotation is stored ALONGSIDE the candidate artifact, keyed by artifact digest — never inside the artifact body. Candidate artifacts are immutable and content-addressed (same commit + toolchain ⇒ identical artifact hash); late-arriving sidecar evidence must not mutate them. Consumers (impact rendering, C9's pre-merge line, UI treatment) join artifact + annotations at read time. Annotations are append-only; multiple test runs on one digest produce multiple annotations.

artifactHash.description: The candidate artifact this evidence was joined to, when resolvable at join time

environment.description: The test environment that produced the evidence; never a production environment (ADR-028 flag policy)

elementMappingsConfirmed.description: Count of explicitly instrumented element mappings confirmed in this run (only where the RuntimeLineageObservation admission gates passed)
